verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state connecting GitHub lets Foreloop read code and lets an agent open pull requests against it (foreloop-docs-15), and the workflow doc describes the agent running in a repo checkout, claiming tasks, and opening a PR from the user's GitHub account (foreloop-docs-3), gated by human contract approval (foreloop-docs-7). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the GitHub connection flow itself (e.g., screenshots, third-party review) and no detail on the actual repo-connect setup UI/permissions scope.
